steps: Bind one Task Anchor to a canonical asset digest, source/license, accepted parent and exact Site commit/version.
Deploy that exact version successfully and prove the fixed URL serves the same commit.
Verify live whole-machine decode/render plus rotate/select/adjust in the original workbench without offline-preview or startup-failure UI.
Capture the same externally accessible URL/version on desktop and a 390x844 browser viewport, then publish a layered Delivery Receipt with known limitations.
boundedMethod.minimalValidation: Exact Task Anchor + succeeded exact-version deployment + fixed-URL commit match + live whole-machine rotate/select/adjust + externally accessible desktop/390x844 evidence + Delivery Receipt.
boundedMethod.falsifier: Any saved-only version, stale live URL, authentication gate, offline/static fallback, partial-only object, startup failure, or missing major interaction.
